body:
**Verification:** Production testing is done. Smoke tested the Company Created/Properties Updated in HubSpot trigger on Production, all 9 activities:

| # | Activity | What was checked | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Add Prospect in Saleshandy | A company created with two contacts selected in the form adds both contacts as prospects (AL-4009). | Pass |
| 2 | Move Prospect to another Sequence in Saleshandy | All three contacts of the company are moved to the configured sequence. | Pass |
| 3 | Assign a tag to Prospect in Saleshandy | The prospect shows the configured tag. | Pass |
| 4 | Mark Prospect as Paused in Saleshandy | The prospect in the configured sequence shows Paused. | Pass |
| 5 | Mark prospect as Resume (Un-pause) in Saleshandy | The paused prospect is no longer Paused. | Pass |
| 6 | Mark prospect as Replied in Saleshandy | The prospect in the configured sequence is marked as replied (sequence stops follow-ups on a reply). | Pass |
| 7 | Mark prospect as Finished in Saleshandy | The prospect in the configured sequence shows Finished. | Pass |
| 8 | Mark Prospect as Unsubscribed in Saleshandy | The prospect shows Unsubscribed. | Pass |
| 9 | Blacklist a Domain in Saleshandy | The prospect's domain is on the Global Do Not Contact list and the prospect shows Blacklisted (list entry removed afterwards). | Pass |

**Note:** AL-4059 (updating company properties does not trigger the workflow) is still open and not covered by this verification, so the Properties Updated path is not checked. A company created with no contact is not a valid scenario and is not checked.
waitingFor: QA to check the wording. Evidence: Production run 2026-10-15 on account emailopenedprod, sequence 'HubSpot Company Created Smoke' (id 974278). Script (tests/hubspot/company-created-smoke.spec.ts) passed Add Prospect, Move, Assign a tag, Paused and Resume; Replied, Finished, Unsubscribed and Blacklist a domain were validated by hand by QA. Script result for Replied failed after 13.4 min (status not read); QA's manual check passed.
